name: GTA V Map Streaming
description: Residency pass: decide which 512 m tiles should be loaded around the player, spawn their instances, and despawn what fell out of range.
rationale: The full map is far too large to hold at once, so tiles are spawned and despawned around the player each frame under a fixed per-frame budget. Load and evict radii differ so that tiles do not thrash when the player walks back and forth over a tile boundary.

steps.comment: The streamer centres on the same origin the movement code just produced, so tiles track the player and not a frame-old camera.
Maps the player origin onto the tile grid and produces the wanted set, biased along velocity by prefetch.velocity_lead_seconds.
Reads assets/tiles/<x>_<z>.json and appends one scene object per placement, amortised across frames. Tiles are taken nearest first so the budget is spent where the player is standing.
Drops the objects of every tile past the evict radius, and of any tile gta5.lod.select flagged for rebuild.
Flags tiles whose distance band changed. Banding is per tile, not per placement: a band change is then one teardown instead of thousands.
